rows.en: ＊Narusawa＊＠１４０＿０１３Got a minute...?￥I need to talk to you.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４０＿０２５You've been slacking on your￥High-G training lately.＝＠１４０＿０１５Keep that up, and you'll fall￥further and further behind the￥other candidates.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４０＿０１６At this rate, you won't have a￥prayer of qualifying!
＊Narusawa＊＠１４０＿０２６Today's meant to be a day off,￥but I'll open the High-G Room￥for you, just this once.＝＠１４０＿０２７You're doing extra training￥with me, starting now!
